data.title: MySQL 0.1.3 SingleStore compatibility candidate
data.description: Review bounded mysql_native_password negotiation, host-owned TLS-mode selection, exact plaintext/TLS sequencing, secret handling, and the unpublished 0.1.3 package candidate.

data.body: Blocking CWE-14: these ordinary fill(0) calls do not survive the optimized Wasm build, so the new mysql_native_password SHA1 stage1, stage2, and stage3 values remain in reusable linear-memory stack pages after token construction. The same issue affects the new caching_sha2 cleanup at lines 184-186. Fresh evidence: just check and just reproducible pass, but wasm-tools print of the optimized component proceeds from digest finalization/token construction without terminal zero stores; heap-backed SecretBytes and connection-secret cleanup do remain as memory.fill, isolating this to optimizer-elided stack wipes. Use optimizer-resistant zeroization and verify the release WAT/binary retains the wipes.

data.reason: CWE-14: optimized Wasm removes the intended SHA1/SHA256 stack-digest fill(0) wipes; use optimizer-resistant zeroization and verify the release binary retains it.

Fixed in 128aecb with zeroize 1.9.0 and a release gate that parses optimized core Wasm. Fresh just dist and just reproducible each report one reachable wipe routine covering 3x20-byte and 3x32-byte digest intermediates; component/package remain byte-reproducible. Please re-review the optimized artifact.

LGTM at 128aecbe6f310252fd709726598caedd70a1379c: zeroize 1.9.0 retains all six SHA-1/SHA-256 intermediate wipes in optimized core Wasm on the exact exported connect path; independent WAT confirms auth digest offsets and byte-loop/barrier semantics. just dist, just reproducible, cargo audit, SDK/package checks pass.

LGTM at e075ec13af3ef14a29008a1154fbfed37e5215ec: only ci.yml changed since reviewed 128aecb. actionlint v1.7.12 reports zero errors; pull_request still runs all PRs, push still runs main, and the complete check/reproducibility/release-identity job is unchanged.
